item.title: ML Engineer, Search Ranking
item.description:
Location: Remote (EU)

Quarry Labs builds product search for e-commerce catalogues.

What you'll do

  • Work closely with product and engineering to ship improvements every week.
  • Own your work from design document to production.

Requirements

  • Python and PyTorch.
  • Spark.
  • Offline and online evaluation of ranking models.
